shared_entity.matching: entity level: the photo is of the hotel or phone model the review is about

shared_web.matching: scene level only: same food/hotel/ecommerce, not the same restaurant or product
shared_web.source_of_photos: photos taken from real reviews in the same scene

table_columns.note: three_class.csv keeps only image_224_path, so the entity of a shared photo has to be recovered by joining text back to two_class.csv; the result is entity_map.csv.

images_per_review.note: every row has at most one image; image_path never carries a '|' separator
